leadText: Keiji (Japanese: ケイジ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.
plainText:
Keiji (Japanese: ケイジ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest. 

==In the games==
 
 

===Warlord information===
====Rank I====
 

====Rank II====
 

Transforms to Rank II by reaching a 70% link with Bastiodon.

===Default Pokémon===
 
 
===Links===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
====Unobtainable links====
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Still not up, eh..."
With low health or a status ailment:
"This ain't looking so great..."
When victory is near:
"Right. Let's clinch this thing."
Otherwise:
"Okay! Looks like it's our turn!"

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle: 
"Time to get down and dirty!"
When defending a castle: 
"Let's tear up the battlefield!"

During battle: 
"A battle for the fate of the kingdom... Come on, ! Let's do this in style!"

When ordering to attack: 
"Hey! !"

When ordering to go to battle: 
To a kingdom:
"I can almost taste it... A battle for the ages is about to begin!"
To a wild Pokémon location:
"Who're we gonna run into, I wonder..."

Upon forming a link: 
"You and I will change the world, !"

When using an item: 
" time!"

When using his Warrior Skill: 
"Set your faces to stunned!"

After winning a battle: 
If he attacked a castle:
"So now you know why they call me Ransei's Greatest Warrior, eh?"
If he defended a castle:
"Yup! How 'bout a round of applause for Ransei's Greatest Warrior?"

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"Whoa, you're good. I'm pretty taken with you..."
If defeated by something other than the enemy:
"Well, you gotta roll with the punches."
Otherwise:
"Well, at least we had some fun, eh?"

When being recruited:
"Excellent! I just hope I don't cause you too much trouble."

When Terrakion appears in a kingdom:
"How interesting! I think I’d better go take a look."

When he has linked with Terrakion:
"Hey! You’re one of those legendary Pokémon, aren’t you?! You look pretty tough–just as I hoped! I can tell you and I are going to do some real damage together!"

At the end of :
"A hundred Pokémon already? Well, that should be enough to keep this place going. I'm a drifter, see. I don't like to be tied down. Not to people, and not to kingdoms. It's not easy sometimes, but it's the only life I know. Looks like the people here don't need me anymore. Time for me to hit the road!"

===Profile===
Stylish, with a love of interesting and unusual things, he has a tendency to drift from kingdom to kingdom. His talent as a Warrior, however, is not to be underestimated.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Keiji debuted in PNA5.
 
====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==

===Historical origin===
Keiji is based on the real-life of Japanese history.
